'''Sanna Olpan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and a resident of the city [[Jorra]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

==Biography==
A resident of the city [[Jorra]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Sanna Olpan and her spouse, [[Hriv Olpan]], had a son named [[Gren Olpan|Gren]] who was little more than a child during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the fighting came to Cato Neimoidia, Olpan's son was arrested by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]] and placed in the [[Southside Prison]] for the crime of conspiring against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Believing her son to be innocent, Olpan held on to her resentment for two decades, during which time she had no knowledge of whether her son was still imprisoned at the facility, dead, or had been released and turned to crime.
